components.name: Accent Button
components.description: The one primary action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { min-height: var(--control-height); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-5); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-on-accent); font: var(--weight-semibold) var(--text-base) var(--font-sans); transition: background-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out), transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover); } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: scale(var(--press-scale)); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: var(--outline-width) solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: var(--outline-offset); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as Save and Clear all.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: var(--control-height); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-5); border: var(--border-width-strong) solid var(--color-line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); font: var(--weight-semibold) var(--text-base) var(--font-sans); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: var(--outline-width) solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: var(--outline-offset); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Toggle chip for categories; green when selected.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: var(--control-height-sm); padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-3); border: var(--border-width) solid var(--color-line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); font: var(--weight-medium) var(--text-sm) var(--font-sans); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: var(--color-selected); background: var(--color-selected); color: var(--color-on-selected); }

components.name: Discount Seal
components.description: The signature element: a tilted yellow sticker whose size steps up with the discount.
components.css: .ds-seal { display: inline-grid; place-content: center; justify-items: center; width: var(--seal-lg); height: var(--seal-lg); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-on-accent); box-shadow: var(--shadow-seal); line-height: 1; transform: rotate(var(--seal-tilt)); transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-press); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-seal:hover { transform: none; } .ds-seal-pct { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: var(--weight-black); letter-spacing: var(--tracking-figure); } .ds-seal-off { font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: var(--weight-bold); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Label above, help or error below.
components.css: .ds-label { display: grid; gap: var(--space-2); font: var(--weight-semibold) var(--text-sm) var(--font-sans); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-input { height: var(--control-height); padding: 0 var(--space-3); border: var(--border-width) solid var(--color-line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-field); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); font: var(--text-base) var(--font-sans); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: var(--outline-width) solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: var(--outline-offset); }

components.name: Shell Navigation
components.description: Green header with a yellow bar under the current section.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: var(--space-1); height: var(--header-height); padding: 0 var(--space-4); background: var(--color-shell); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 var(--space-3); color: var(--color-on-shell-muted); font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--color-on-shell); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--color-on-shell); font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: var(--space-3); right: var(--space-3); bottom: 0; height: var(--space-1); border-radius: var(--radius-pill) var(--radius-pill) 0 0; background: var(--color-accent); }

narrative.northStar: The carrier bag and its paper seal
narrative.overview: A bargain is something you carry home wrapped. Bargainu borrows the department-store carrier bag and its paper seal: one bottle green for the shell, one saffron-yellow sticker for the discount, and everything else is paper and ink. The surface is an Operate screen, so the world lends only type, palette, density and one signature move; layout, navigation and controls are standard.
keyCharacteristics: Bottle-green shell, green-tinted paper ground, green-black ink
One accent: yellow, for the seal and the primary action
Cardless deal tiles with the seal straddling the photo edge
Pills for anything pressed, soft corners for anything that holds
Flat depth: tone and hairlines, three shadows in total

rules.name: The One Sticker Rule
rules.body: Yellow means the discount or the main thing to press. Nothing else is yellow.

rules.name: Selection is green
rules.body: Selected state never uses the accent.

rules.name: Figures are tabular
rules.body: Every price, percent, count and time uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: Three things float
rules.body: Only the seal, the toast and the sheet carry a shadow.

dos: Do read every value from tokens.css
Do put the seal on every deal photo and nowhere else
Do keep store names as plain text
Do show real counts and real time left
donts: Don't add a second accent, gradient, glass or glow
Don't box deals in bordered or shadowed cards
Don't use yellow for selection or red for discounts
Don't add eyebrows, section numbers or entrance animations
